== Title ==
<span lang="ja">感知</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-267o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：運命数を引き、運命数＜（場に出ている中で、最も能力値の高い自分のキャラクターの能力値）であれば、インタラプト（か“リアクション”）を１つキャンセルする。２：今使用されたばかりの「意識操作」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「なにかを感じる。久しく触れることのなかったなにかを…」</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Sense.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Draw destiny. If it is less than the ability of your highest-ability character on table, cancel one Interrupt or react. 2. Cancel an Alter that has just been used.

'''Lore:''' “I sense something. Something I haven't felt in a long time…”

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3
* '''Printed subtype:''' Used Interrupt<ref name="jp-face" />
